newsitem.title: USA: Pegasus takes over DirecTV in Texas, Mich.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus takes over DirecTV in Texas, Mich.

text.p: Pegasus Communications Corp said it had acquired the DBS operations of Harron Communications Corp for about $29.8 million in cash and stock.
Pegasus said it would become the exclusive provider of direct satellite service DirecTV of Hughes Electronics Corp in certain rural areas of Michigan and Texas as a result of the purchase.
It said Harron served more than 10,500 customers in areas consisting of 391,000 television households and 20,000 business locations in rural areas of Michigan and Texas.

Pegasus, the largest independent provider of DirecTV, also said it had entered into a letter of intent regarding its acquisition of the DirecTV distribution rights and related assets of the fifth largest independent provider of the service whose exclusive territory serves certain rural areas of Ohio.
